commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: install cluster private key for ssh to node1 =="
mkdir -p ~/.ssh
chmod 700 ~/.ssh
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PRIVKEY" > ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_cluster
chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_cluster

echo "== STEP 2: resolve node1 IP from CLUSTER_HOSTS =="
NODE1_IP=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node1"{print $1}')
echo "node1 ip: $NODE1_IP"
echo "$NODE1_IP" > /tmp/node1_ip.txt

echo "== STEP 3: known_hosts pre-trust =="
ssh-keyscan -H "$NODE1_IP" >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 600 ~/.ssh/known_hosts

echo "== STEP 4: create target dir =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/inventory

echo "== STEP 5: write sync script =="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-app-conf.sh > /dev/null <<'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
NODE1_IP=$(cat /tmp/node1_ip.txt)
KEY=/home/antrieb/.ssh/id_ed25519_cluster
DEST=/etc/inventory/app.conf
TMP=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT

if ! /usr/bin/ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 \
    antrieb@"$NODE1_IP" "sudo -n cat /etc/inventory/app.conf" > "$TMP" 2>>/var/log/inventory-sync.log; then
    echo "$(date -Iseconds) ERROR: failed to fetch app.conf from node1" >> /var/log/inventory-sync.log
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s "$TMP" ]; then
    echo "$(date -Iseconds) ERROR: fetched empty app.conf, refusing to sync" >> /var/log/inventory-sync.log
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$DEST" ] || ! cmp -s "$TMP" "$DEST"; then
    /usr/bin/install -o root -g root -m 644 "$TMP" "$DEST"
    echo "$(date -Iseconds) SYNCED: app.conf updated from node1" >> /var/log/inventory-sync.log
else
    echo "$(date -Iseconds) NOCHANGE: app.conf already up to date" >> /var/log/inventory-sync.log
fi
SCRIPT_EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-app-conf.sh
sudo -n touch /var/log/inventory-sync.log
sudo -n chown antrieb:antrieb /var/log/inventory-sync.log

echo "== STEP 6: install crontab entry (every 5 min, well within 15 min SLA) =="
( crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v sync-inventory-app-conf.sh || true; echo "*/5 * * * * /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-app-conf.sh" ) | crontab -
crontab -l

echo "== STEP 7: run sync once now to seed initial copy =="
sudo -n /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-app-conf.sh
cat /var/log/inventory-sync.log

echo "== STEP 8: verify synced content matches =="
sudo -n cat /etc/inventory/app.conf
sha256sum /etc/inventory/app.conf 2>&1 || sudo -n sha256sum /etc/inventory/app.conf
